---
name: 'HL7 AT: Ballot Comment'
about: Submit a ballot comment on this IG
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

**Real Submitter**
Who is the real submitter, in case the creation of the issue was done by proxy.

**Page**
Page the comment refers to (e.g. workflow.html).

**Line / Anchor**
Line number or anchor the comment refers to (e.g. #app-pairing).

**Element**
Element the comment refers to (e.g. gh:bpk, ssn).

**Description**
A clear and concise description of the comment.

**Proposed Change**
The change you suggest.

**Rationale / Comment / Question**
Rationale, comment, or question providing further context.

**Assessment**
Assessment of this comment - one of:
- (NEG-S) Negative, severe
- (NEG-G) Negative, minor
- (Z-K) Agree with comment
- (Z-V) Agree with suggestion
- (Z-T) Agree - typo
- (Z-F) Agree with question
- (K) Comment

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the comment here.
